title: Report Status
description:
report-status/v1 — the document every report-status event carries, on all five event types (report-status, -completed, -incomplete, -resolved, -rejected). It records progress on a report authored by an earlier margin-report event, which the event references.

The document spans TWO INDEPENDENT AXES and the `status` value says which one applies. Evaluation statuses (new, in_progress, completed, incomplete) are measured by the valuation engine from the collateral actually posted; they overlay the report's single status. Dispositions (resolved, rejected) are declared per organization and accumulate — one report can be `completed` and still carry a rejection from each party. The event TYPE mirrors the terminal values so a state machine can act on them without reading this document.

reportId.description: The report this status is about. The event also references the authoring margin-report event, which is the protocol-level counterpart of this field.

status.description: EVALUATION axis — new = authored, nothing posted yet; in_progress = partially covered; completed = coverage reached the nominal; incomplete = the deadline passed without coverage. DISPOSITION axis — resolved = this org considers its close-out done; rejected = this org disputes the report. `in_complete` is a legacy spelling of incomplete found on older logs.

resolvedBy.description: Organization declaring the resolution. Present only when status is `resolved`; a resolution is per-org, so several may exist for one report.

rejectedBy.description: Organization declaring the rejection. Present only when status is `rejected`.

note.description: Free-text explanation. Carried by dispositions; evaluation transitions leave it empty.

allOf.description: A resolution names the org that resolved.
A rejection names the org that rejected.
